verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents an agent skill and official MCP server that let agents create sandboxes from prompts. Every sandbox exposes an MCP server so agents can run processes and handle files through tool calls, and agents can read results via filesystem reads and batch or streaming log retrieval. Lifecycle cleanup is covered through expiration and TTL auto-deletion and archive/shutdown, with API keys enabling unattended auth. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented agent-initiated on-demand sandbox delete call, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the full unattended provision-to-teardown loop.
